# events

```go
import "github.com/effective-security/trustyca/internal/events"
```

Package events records audit events for the actions users, API keys and the service take on orgs, projects, members and users.

New starts an event with its type, title and the emitting component; the builder methods scope it to an org and project, set the referenced entity and the details. Emit hands it to a Recorder, such as db.OrgsDb, which writes it in the background and logs a failure instead of returning it, so emit only after the action it records has succeeded. ParseTimeRange validates the time filters of an event list request.

```
events.New(ctx, ServiceName, pb.EventType_ProjectCreated, "Project created").
	Org(orgID).
	Project(project.ID).
	Reference(project.ID).
	Description("project %q created", project.Name).
	Emit(s.db)
```
